headline: Generative models of single-cell dynamics predict fate and perturbation responses
label: Generative Single Cell Dynamics Models
summary: Generative flows, neural ODEs, and lineage-based inference now predict cell-state transitions with explicit fate and perturbation targets.
synthesis: The dominant thread is generative modeling of single-cell state dynamics tied to explicit fate or perturbation targets. LineageFlow applies growth-corrected generative flows to predict clonal fate distributions and expression from early single-cell lineage data. DynaVelo, a generative neural ODE over joint gene expression and TF motif dynamics in single-cell multiome data, performs in silico loss-of-function and rescue perturbations in B cells. isCORAL takes a complementary route, inferring clonal relationships and fate maps from single-cell and spatial transcriptomes via heritable memory genes, and reports outperforming alternatives. Bolero is adjacent rather than dynamical: a sequence-to-function model conditioned on cell-state embeddings that predicts cell-state-specific accessibility and expression from DNA across species. What is new across these items is that generative dynamics are assessed through concrete fate and perturbation outputs.
